blurb: Located at 332 W. Mercer Street in downtown Dripping Springs, Mercer Street Chic Botique & Art Gallery is a one-of-a-kind boutique and art gallery built on a simple belief: people first, profits second. Browse handpicked western fashion, specialty boots, handcrafted jewelry, and a rotating gallery of original works by Hill Country artists.
